VOLTAGE — THIRD-PARTY CABINET CREDITS

Cabinet impulse responses by Jester Dyne Productions / Bastian Karschewski.
Both source-pack handbooks dedicate the IRs under Creative Commons CC0 1.0.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Legal code: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

GREENBACK — cabinets/greenback.wav
Source: Emerald Pack 1.0
https://www.jester-dyne-productions.com/emerald-ir-pack/
https://www.jester-dyne-productions.com/content/files/2023/04/Emerald-Pack-1.0.zip
Original file: Emerald Pack 1.0/Impulses/48kHz/3_Wasabi_Warrior_48.wav
Capture: 1998 Marshall 1960AX, Celestion Greenback G12M25W speakers,
Shure SM57 on the upper-left speaker. Microphone angle unspecified.

VINTAGE 30 — cabinets/v30.wav
Source: Jester's Brutal Pack 1.0
https://www.jester-dyne-productions.com/brutal-ir-pack/
https://www.jester-dyne-productions.com/content/files/2023/04/JestersBrutalPack_1.0.zip
Original file: Jesters_Brutal_Pack_1.0/Impulses/48kHz/1_Cookie_Monster.wav
Capture: modified oversized Behringer BG412S cabinet, Celestion Vintage 30
speakers, Shure SM57 on an upper speaker. Microphone angle unspecified.

The redistributed mono 48 kHz / 24-bit WAV files are unchanged.
At runtime Voltage resamples to the audio context's rate, retains the first
85 ms with the original onset, fades the final 10 ms and calibrates their
midrange response. Custom IRs retain their full permitted length and use
the same reference-band calibration.

Original handbooks, including each CC0 notice on page 3, are retained at:
https://github.com/Yohann-Gentelet/voltage-guitar-studio/tree/main/docs/licenses

Amp design, equations, research references and measurement method:
https://github.com/Yohann-Gentelet/voltage-guitar-studio/blob/main/docs/amp-model.md

Manufacturer names identify the captured hardware. Voltage is not affiliated
with or endorsed by these manufacturers. Its amp voices are original
behavioral designs; only the identified cabinet recordings are measured IRs.
